sampling.algorithm: selectable sampler and scheduler with a backward-compatible dual-clock default
sampling.sampler_options: current comfy.samplers.SAMPLER_NAMES when native ModelSamplingAV is available
sampling.alternate_sampler_protocol: native FLOW_AV carry/scale; unavailable on legacy ComfyUI
sampling.legacy_workflow_compatibility: new optional widgets are appended after steps/shift_video/shift_audio
comfyui_audio_velocity_compatibility: current FLOW_AV raw H3 audio velocity

experimental_sampling.video_update_policy: one frozen-derivative macro update per video step
comfyui_audio_velocity_compatibility: current FLOW_AV raw H3 audio velocity
experimental_sampling.status: experimental; does not replace or modify the stable dual-clock node

experimental_still_image_edit.status: experimental semantic reference editing; not mask-based pixel editing

validated_probe.scope: one perceptual probe; not a broad quality benchmark

experimental_long_video.state_strategy: CPU tail-only safetensors, exact N-1 slot, checksum validation, atomic replace
experimental_long_video.accepted_state_strategy: candidate preview is non-mutating; accepted manifest uses a lock, SHA-256, atomic replace, one valid backup, parent-candidate identity, and explicit downstream invalidation on replacement
experimental_long_video.model_patch_scope: cloned MODEL object patch; no process-global PackedLayout or MiniMaxH3 monkey patch
experimental_long_video.video_context_strategy: direct sampler video-latent tail; no video VAE decode/re-encode
experimental_long_video.continuation_rule: non-final output reaches sampled tail; exact hidden-tail trim only on final segment
experimental_long_video.segment_output: ComfyUI core CreateVideo -> SaveVideo; avoids the tested VHS apad/-shortest audio underrun
experimental_long_video.orchestration: total duration is quantized once to 24fps; a fixed 17n+5 render window bounds every segment; accepted manifest length selects the next segment; global/per-segment prompt and fixed/increment/hash seeds are supported; steps, shifts, sampler and scheduler are emitted from the same plan to both sampling and candidate identity; a complete final manifest blocks downstream sampling

background_executor.activation: review_only is the safe default; auto_accept_and_continue must be selected explicitly and accepts every successful candidate without human review
background_executor.queue_rule: the start node snapshots the current API prompt in memory before expensive work; the terminal accepts one candidate and validates/queues exactly one next prompt
background_executor.retry_rule: 0-10 additional attempts per failed segment; the exact prompt is reused and resolution, frames, context, sampler, scheduler and seed are never silently reduced

release_policies.clear_execution_cache: default; explicitly sets unload_models=false and free_memory=true
release_policies.unload_all_models: strong global ComfyUI unload; it is not H3-only

background_executor.release_timing: the selected policy is requested after every durable acceptance, including continue, pause and final; failure preserves the accepted manifest and stops without regeneration
background_executor.prompt_snapshot_sanitization: ComfyUI runtime is_changed fingerprints are removed both when capturing and when requeueing a prompt so an advanced keep_loaded segment cannot become a false whole-graph cache hit
background_executor.persistence: background_job.json stores state and prompt SHA-256 but never the prompt body; after a ComfyUI restart the workflow must be queued once to reattach the in-memory prompt snapshot
background_executor.process_ownership: one OS-owned background_job.lock.v2 lease per chain rejects another ComfyUI process before generation and is released automatically on process death
background_executor.manifest_locking: OS-owned manifest.lock.v2 serializes same-host commits and releases on process death; live legacy locks are respected and dead legacy residue remains rollback-compatible
background_executor.disk_schema_migration: accepted manifests and background states use explicit schema-2 format markers; valid schema-1 files normalize in memory without read-time mutation, then upgrade on the next protected write while preserving the raw v1 manifest backup; unknown future schemas fail closed
background_executor.error_privacy: persisted errors use an allowlist and exclude ComfyUI current_inputs/current_outputs, media tensors, and prompt text
background_executor.composition: the final accepted manifest may be composed automatically; post-accept composition errors fail the job without retrying from an already-advanced manifest

validated_background_executor_probe.synthetic_controls: live isolated ComfyUI checks passed two-segment auto queue/composition, pause-after-current then resume, targeted running-prompt cancel with no accepted manifest, and one exact-prompt retry followed by bounded failure
validated_background_executor_probe.real_checkpoint: minimax_h3_fl2va_int8_convrot + Standard Turbo EMA LoRA + Qwen3-VL NVFP4 + both H3 VAEs
validated_background_executor_probe.result: two distinct prompt ids succeeded; manifest revision 2 accepted 124+20=144 frames; automatic final H.264/AAC composition produced exact 6.000-second streams
validated_background_executor_probe.scope: mechanical executor and strong-release probe only; 256x256 one-step output is not a quality benchmark or a general memory_safe/never-OOM result

validated_release_policy_ab.controlled_input: three paired seeds; FL2VA INT8; Standard four-step Turbo LoRA; 736x416; 124-frame render window; 22-frame AV context; two segments; six seconds; DynamicVRAM headroom 2GiB
validated_release_policy_ab.protocol: three fresh-process cold trials per policy; one unmeasured same-process primer followed by three measured warm trials per policy; 21 chains total and 18 measured
validated_release_policy_ab.result: 21/21 chains completed without retry or OOM; all 18 measured chains reached manifest revision 2
validated_release_policy_ab.output_identity: for every seed, segment videos, accepted AV-tail tensor payload, and final H.264/AAC file hashes matched across all six policy/cold-warm conditions
validated_release_policy_ab.cache_evidence: keep_loaded cached only unchanged loader nodes 1-5; clear_execution_cache and unload_all_models had no cached nodes; orchestration, sampling, saving and terminal acceptance always reran
validated_release_policy_ab.decision: keep clear_execution_cache as the balanced default; keep_loaded trades 17.39s cold and 31.97s warm speed gains for about 6.8GiB extra residency, while global unload had no material peak advantage and was 12.05s slower warm

validated_crash_recovery_and_multichain.crash_boundary: owned ComfyUI process killed after segment 0 durable acceptance at manifest revision 1 while the next prompt was active
validated_crash_recovery_and_multichain.restart_result: status reconciled stale running to detached with accepted_count 1 and queue_workflow_once; one requeue created a new job linked by previous_job_id and generated segment 1 only
validated_crash_recovery_and_multichain.unchanged_evidence: segment 0 candidate identity, MP4 SHA-256, AV-tail tensor SHA-256, and file modification timestamp remained unchanged
validated_crash_recovery_and_multichain.multichain_result: two independent real H3 chains completed revision 2 in A0-B0-A1-B1 order on one serial ComfyUI prompt queue with isolated jobs, prompts, parents, roots, manifests, and final files
validated_crash_recovery_and_multichain.native_v2_result: the pre-kill background state and accepted manifest, resumed revision-2 chain, and both interleaved revision-2 chains used the exact schema-2 format markers
validated_crash_recovery_and_multichain.scope: native-v2 repeat validates one post-acceptance hard-kill boundary and same-queue chain isolation; not a complete upgrade/downgrade matrix across separately released plugin/ComfyUI builds, network/shared-filesystem locking, arbitrary-instruction recovery, simultaneous CUDA execution, or multi-GPU parallelism

validated_local_multiprocess_reliability.platform_scope: same-host Windows/NTFS using the installed ComfyUI Python
validated_local_multiprocess_reliability.same_slot_acceptance: two processes competed for different candidates at the same chain/index/revision; exactly one committed revision 1 and the loser was rejected before an accepted copy
validated_local_multiprocess_reliability.lock_stress: four processes performed 25 protected updates each and retained all 100 updates
validated_local_multiprocess_reliability.kill_release: a forcibly terminated manifest-lock owner was replaced in under two seconds
validated_local_multiprocess_reliability.background_ownership: a second ComfyUI process was rejected before generation; after killing the first owner, a third process attached and linked previous_job_id
validated_local_multiprocess_reliability.upgrade_safety: live legacy lock respected even past old age threshold; dead legacy residue does not block and is not deleted; valid schema-1 manifest/background state normalizes to schema 2 without read-time mutation and upgrades on the next protected write; raw v1 manifest backup is preserved; unknown schemas fail closed without backup rollback; same-schema additive fields survive later commits
validated_local_multiprocess_reliability.real_v1_read_only_evidence: an existing real H3 schema-1 chain loaded as schema 2 with migrated_from_schema=1 while both raw file SHA-256 values remained unchanged
validated_local_multiprocess_reliability.acceptance_transaction_fault_injection: eight deterministic cases cover hash-verified idempotent asset repair without revision change, active/invalidated candidate-id path collision refusal, context-copy interruption, failure after backup but before primary replacement, valid-backup recovery when primary is missing even with allow_new, and fail-closed unknown/corrupt backup behavior
validated_local_multiprocess_reliability.acceptance_transaction_process_kill: on same-host Windows/NTFS, a worker holding manifest.lock.v2 was forcibly killed after accepted-video copy before context/manifest and after revision-1 backup before revision-2 primary replacement; three independent rounds covered both breakpoints and all 6/6 recovered in under two seconds without a stale worker or lost revision
validated_local_multiprocess_reliability.corruption_recovery: semantically invalid primary never replaces a valid backup; unreadable auxiliary background state is quarantined and recovered from the accepted manifest; unknown future background schema is never overwritten
validated_local_multiprocess_reliability.scope: deterministic fault injection plus two repeated real-process killpoints cover named program boundaries with small test media, not arbitrary CPU instructions, live-H3 CUDA termination, or storage power loss; network/shared filesystems, a complete upgrade/downgrade matrix across separately released plugin/ComfyUI versions, simultaneous same-chain generation, and multi-GPU execution remain unvalidated

validated_background_four_step_long_chai.bound_contract: RTX 4060 Ti 16GiB; FL2VA INT8 ConvRot; Standard four-step Turbo LoRA; Qwen3-VL NVFP4; both H3 VAEs; 736x416; 124-frame render window; 22-frame AV context; dual_clock_euler/native_flow shift12/3; DynamicVRAM headroom 2.0GiB; unload_all_models between segments
validated_background_four_step_long_chai.result: 14 distinct prompt ids all succeeded once without retry or OOM; manifest revision 14 contains 1440 contiguous frames and 1920000 audio samples; every accepted media/context hash and parent identity validates; automatic H.264/AAC video, audio and container streams are exactly 60.000 seconds
validated_background_four_step_long_chai.growth_evidence: running maximum reached 12784.24MiB at segment 3, increased only 38.89MiB at segment 9, then remained flat through segment 14; this single sequence shows no staircase leak
validated_background_four_step_long_chai.determinism_evidence: the same prompt/seed segment-0 MP4 is bit-identical to the six-second preflight; context-file identity metadata differs while video_tail and audio_tail tensor payloads are bit-identical
validated_background_four_step_long_chai.video_seam_evidence: 13 seams: MAD median/max 0.04696/0.07420 and SSIM median/min 0.73139/0.64589; only 2 seams were locally highest MAD and inspection found no obvious hard cut in this walking-shot sample
validated_background_four_step_long_chai.audio_seam_evidence: adjacent half-second level-change median -0.42dB and maximum absolute 13.75dB; 5ms bridge reduced median single-sample jump about 96.16 percent but does not repair level, semantics, rhythm, timbre or lip sync
validated_background_four_step_long_chai.final_release_followup: after fixing release timing, a real 256x256 one-step/two-segment chain recorded last_release_policy=unload_all_models and whole-device use fell from about 8124MiB at completion to 1230MiB within 15 seconds without a manual /free call
validated_background_four_step_long_chai.scope: one local fixed-profile prompt/seed pass; repeated cold/warm runs, multiple materials, other GPUs, high resolutions/references, actual cross-version migration, network/shared-filesystem behavior and true GPU parallelism remain unverified; not a universal memory_safe, seamless or never-OOM claim

validated_auto_resume_probe.result: two-segment candidate generation, accepted-parent/context auto-resume, machine-bound four-step sampling identity, acceptance, complete-chain block, and accepted-file composition succeeded with exact 6.0s A/V streams
validated_auto_resume_probe.seam_evidence: 5ms bridge reduced the post-AAC single-sample jump by about 80.2%, but a 33.3dB adjacent-window level drop and locally maximal video MAD/SSIM discontinuity prevent a seamless claim
validated_auto_resume_probe.scope: one two-segment real execution probe; not an 8-16 segment perceptual-quality, blind-listening, or VRAM safety result

validated_long_chain_probe.memory_mode: one uninterrupted DynamicVRAM process; no explicit /free between segments
validated_long_chain_probe.result: 14-segment candidate generation, accepted-parent/context resume, acceptance, exact completion blocking, and unbridged/bridge composition succeeded with 1440-frame 60.000s A/V streams
validated_long_chain_probe.video_seam_evidence: 13 seams: MAD median/max 0.01618/0.01906 and SSIM median/min 0.96374/0.92868; no hard cut in inspected worst contacts, but gradual appearance/exposure drift is visible
validated_long_chain_probe.audio_seam_evidence: adjacent half-second level-change median -9.51dB, maximum absolute 40.83dB; above-8kHz energy ratio changed -36.30dB from first to last segment; bridge reduced median post-AAC sample jump 97.23% but did not repair long-term audio degradation
validated_long_chain_probe.scope: one prompt/seed warm run; proves exact bounded execution, not identity preservation, seamless/lossless audio, blind-listening quality, cold/warm repeatability, or a 16GB safety tier

validated_local_memory_policy.bound_contract: RTX 4060 Ti 16GiB; FL2VA INT8 ConvRot; Standard four-step Turbo LoRA; 736x416; 124-frame render window; 22-frame AV context; dual_clock_euler/native_flow shift12/3; current whitelisted plugin set
validated_local_memory_policy.controlled_matrix: Stock and Sage each completed three cold and three warm trials at 736x416 and 1056x608 with every trial above 512MiB free; matching strategy+seed cold/warm outputs were bit-identical; VRAM polling was 0.10 seconds
validated_local_memory_policy.blockcache_decision: not default: the default threshold hit 0 of 4 forwards, retained about 117.7MiB CPU cache, and cannot skip the mandatory first full forward
validated_local_memory_policy.sage_decision: high-risk approximate speed experiment only: faster, but higher whole-device peak than Stock at equal headroom and material camera/pose/trajectory divergence in two of three 1056x608 seeds
validated_local_memory_policy.full_chain_result: Stock+h2 completed 14/14 accepted segments without restart or explicit /free; revision 14, 1440 frames, 1920000 audio samples, and both assembled H.264/AAC outputs were exact 60.000-second 736x416 24fps streams
validated_local_memory_policy.full_chain_growth_evidence: warm first-to-last +182.81MiB and descriptive OLS +26.31MiB/segment, but the sequence was non-monotonic and did not show a staircase leak
validated_local_memory_policy.determinism_evidence: versus the prior same-prompt/same-seed Stock headroom-0.5 chain, all 14 segment MP4 SHA-256 values and all 13 continuation video_tail/audio_tail tensor payloads were identical
validated_local_memory_policy.policy_delta: median peak reduced about 2635MiB while total generation time increased about 1.63 percent
validated_local_memory_policy.full_chain_three_seed_protocol: three independent ComfyUI cold-start processes with base seeds 2608082000, 2608083101, and 2608083202; prompt, model, canvas, render window, AV context, sampling, and Stock+headroom-2.0 policy held fixed
validated_local_memory_policy.full_chain_three_seed_result: 42/42 segments completed once with no OOM, retry, or candidate reuse; candidate/accepted video and context hashes, parent/revision chains, raw schema 1/2/2 manifests, 1440 frames, 1920000 samples, completion blocking, and six exact 60.000-second assemblies independently passed
validated_local_memory_policy.full_chain_three_seed_quality: local worst-seam contacts had no obvious hard cut, but all three timelines accumulated facial-age and identity drift; maximum adjacent half-second audio level gaps were 23.59-48.06dB, descriptive NCC medians 0.127-0.206, final-versus-first above-8kHz energy ratios -9.66 to -36.30dB, and the 5ms bridge reduced median post-AAC single-sample jumps 94.93-97.33 percent without repairing level, timbre, semantics, or recursive dulling
validated_local_memory_policy.decision: validated local conservative profile only; the fixed-profile cross-base-seed cold-start mechanical/memory gate passed, but long-term identity quality failed; this is not a general memory_safe tier or never-OOM guarantee, and same-seed whole-chain warm repeats, cross-prompt/material coverage, other GPUs, higher resolutions/reference counts, and desktop VRAM pressure still require separate gates

persistent_first_frame_identity_referenc.status: implemented with a continuation-only dedicated identity image, single-reference or scene-plus-identity strategies, and an optional fixed injection interval; two unseen 32-second chains passed local mechanical/VRAM screens, but rhythm adherence, one multi-person framing seam, and lip-sync evidence remain unresolved; default off
persistent_first_frame_identity_referenc.input: first_frame_reuse, persistent_identity_image, persistent_identity_strategy, and persistent_identity_interval are appended to MiniMaxH3LongVideoConditioningT8; segment0_only plus single_reference plus interval 1 are backward-compatible defaults
persistent_first_frame_identity_referenc.behavior: segment 0 always keeps first_frame as the exact keyframe; on continuation, single_reference prefers the dedicated identity crop and falls back to the full first frame, while scene_plus_identity emits the full scene and crop as two non-timeline references alongside motion keyframes and the marked continuation-audio window; interval N injects only on continuation segments 1, 1+N, 1+2N, and so on
persistent_first_frame_identity_referenc.compatibility: old input/widget prefixes and missing API values preserve segment0_only plus single_reference; the dedicated image is ignored unless persistent mode is active and never changes segment 0; no stable node, sampling math, global ComfyUI object, model, or full-history state is changed
persistent_first_frame_identity_referenc.fail_closed: persistent mode requires first_frame, scene_plus_identity additionally requires persistent_identity_image, actual persistent plus user reference image count is capped at nine, and explicit FL2VA with references is rejected in favor of auto/Hybrid
persistent_first_frame_identity_referenc.cost_boundary: one or two additional image-reference blocks and reference-image VAE encodes per continuation can increase sequence length, runtime, and VRAM or overconstrain motion
